decisionsTitle: «Cronometrare» asks before a finished elite's number typed again is recorded, at the moment of the tap (amending §986)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-20, the day before the race:** «Also, improvements: after an elite arrives and is marked as a finisher, if somebody types that again than we need a confirmation message, this is just for elites sincer their timing is more sensitive». A number pressed twice was already harmless on the server (§986: the first «Sosit» stays, the second press goes to «Istoricul sosirilor»), but an elite's time is the one the race is watched for, and an elite's number typed in the box after the elite's own button turned green is far more often a slip — a digit mistyped, a second volunteer who did not see the button — than a second crossing.

**Decision.**

1. **Asked first, in the box.** When the number typed in «Numărul de pe BIB» (Enter or «Sosit») is an elite's — a registration marked «Elită» or a numbered line of the race's elite list, as the page's state holds them — and that elite is already «Sosit», or the phone already holds the signed-in account's own press of that number since the gun the line counts from, waiting to leave or saved and not undone (`domain/finish-line.ts#asksBeforeAgain`), nothing is recorded yet. The house's one dialog (`ConfirmDialog`, §384) asks «{label} ({name}) a sosit deja la {time} — introdus de {by}. Îl treci din nou?» — who entered it as «Ultimii sosiți» says it («modificat de» once «Clasament» changed it, «cont șters» for an account gone), left out while the elite is not among them —, says «Al doilea timp nu-l schimbă pe primul: apare doar în «Istoricul sosirilor», la «Clasament».», and offers two answers of at least 44 pixels, one under the other at 320 pixels: «Anulează», focused, and «Trece-l din nou» in the error colour of a press the trail keeps for good (`destructive`), so Enter never answers it: a second Enter reaches the focused «Anulează», as Esc and the backdrop do. The words are in both catalogues (`Admin.timing.eliteAgain.*`, each under 200 characters), handed to the island by the page as its other words.
2. **The moment is the tap's.** The moment a press stands for is read when «Sosit» is pressed (`tapMoment`: the oldest kept «Finish» moment still young, else now on the server's clock) and handed to the press, which only then lets go of the kept moment it read (`keptAfterPress`). «Trece-l din nou» records that moment however long the question stayed open — never the moment of the answer — and the server answers it a duplicate as before; «Anulează» records nothing and leaves the kept moment to the next number. A kept moment the second's sweep dropped for paper while the question was open still goes to that press, and leaves the paper line. The box is empty and focused either way. Only the open question's first answer counts, and the dialog stays drawn while it fades, so a double tap answers once and never reaches the button under it. An elite's button and a number nobody asks about take their moment the same way, at the tap.
3. **Only elites, only the box.** Any other number typed again, and an elite who has not crossed yet, go at once as before. An elite's own button stays disabled once «Sosit», as §986 drew it; a page that had not heard yet still sends its press, which the server answers as a duplicate. Another account's press left on the phone, a press undone since and a press before the gun — the trial before «Resetează clasamentul» (§997) — ask nothing. With scripts off there is no question: the plain form posts and the server keeps the first time.
4. The guide's «Cronometrare» step that explains a number pressed twice gains one sentence, and so does the runbook's step at the finish.

**Refused.** A question for every number typed twice: the owner asked for the elites alone, and a bunch finish has no time for a question a runner. A question on the elite's own button, drawn disabled once «Sosit».

**Not in this change.** The server — a duplicate stays harmless, kept in the trail —, the other numbers, the elites' buttons and «Clasament».
changelogLine: - **«Cronometrare» asks before an elite is entered twice** — the number of an elite already «Sosit», typed in the box, opens a question first: «Anulează» (focused, so Enter or Esc) records nothing and keeps a caught «Finish» moment for the next number, «Trece-l din nou» records the moment «Sosit» was pressed and the first time stays; any other number goes at once as before. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criterion 294 for an elite already in. Given «Cronometrare» with scripts on, when the number typed in «Numărul de pe BIB» and sent by Enter or «Sosit» is that of an elite on the page — a registration marked «Elită» or a numbered line of the race's elite list — already «Sosit», or one of which the signed-in account's own press since the gun waits or was saved on that phone, then nothing is recorded yet and the house's confirmation dialog asks «<label> (<name>) a sosit deja la <time> — introdus de <staff name>. Îl treci din nou?» (who entered it only while the elite is among «Ultimii sosiți»), says «Al doilea timp nu-l schimbă pe primul: apare doar în «Istoricul sosirilor», la «Clasament».», and offers «Anulează», focused, and «Trece-l din nou», each at least 44 pixels tall and inside a 320-pixel screen, in Romanian and in English (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `results/finish-line.test.ts`; integration `results/timing-page.test.ts`; e2e `race-finish-quick.spec.ts`.

Given that question, when it is answered «Anulează», a second Enter, Esc or the backdrop, then nothing is recorded, no kept «Finish» moment is used and the box is empty and focused; when it is answered «Trece-l din nou», then the number is pressed at the moment read when «Sosit» was pressed — the oldest kept «Finish» moment still young, else that instant on the server's clock — never at the answer, the server keeping the first time and writing the second to the trail as for any number pressed twice; only the open question's first answer counts (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `results/finish-line.test.ts`; e2e `race-finish-quick.spec.ts`.

Given «Cronometrare», when the number typed is no elite's, or that of an elite who has not crossed yet, then it is pressed at once with no question, as before; an elite's own button stays disabled once «Sosit» and never asks; another account's press left on the phone, a press undone since and a press before the gun ask nothing; with scripts off the plain form posts with no question (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `results/finish-line.test.ts`; e2e `race-finish-quick.spec.ts`.
